verses.en: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.sm: Iotama, o le atalii lea o Usia le tupu o Iuta, na o ae ai i Ierusalema o Resina le tupu o Suria, ma Peka le atalii o Remalia le tupu o Isaraelu, e tau ai le taua, a ua le mafai ona manumalo i ai.

verses.en: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
verses.sm: Ua taʻu atu foi i le aiga o Tavita, ua faapea atu, O loo fesoasoani Efaraima ia Suria; ona gatete ai lea o lona loto, ma loto o lona nuu, pei ona luluina o laau o le vao i le matagi.

verses.en: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o le ALI ia Isaia, Alu ia e faafetaiai ia Aasa, o oe, ma lou atalii o Sarasopa, i le pito alavai i le lepa aupito i luga, i le ala tele i le fanua o le taofu,

verses.en: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.sm: ma ia e fai atu ia te ia, la oe, ia e fifilemu, aua e te fefe, aua neʻi faavaivai foi lou loto ona o ia fu aulama e lua ua pupusa, o le ita tele lea o Resina ma Suria, atoa ma le atalii o Remalia.

verses.en: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
verses.sm: § Auā ua taupulepule e fai se mea leaga ia te oe e Suria, Efaraima, ma le atalii 0 Remalia, ua faapea ane,

verses.en: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
verses.sm: Ia tatou o ae i Iuta, ma faaatuatuvale ia te i latou, ia tatou lepetia se ala mo i tatou, ma ia tatou faatuina ai se tupu, o le atalii o Tapala lea.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii le ATUA, E le tu lea mea, e le oo lava.

verses.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
verses.sm: Aua o le ulu o Suria, o Tamaseko lea; o le ulu foi o Tamaseko, o Resina lea; a oo foi i le onogafulu ma le lima o tausaga, ona lafoia ai lea o Efaraima, e le toe fai ma nuu.

verses.en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
verses.sm: O le ulu foi o Efaraima, o Samaria lea; o le ulu foi o Samaria, o le atalii o Remalia ia; afai tou te le faatuatua, ona le faatumauina ai lea o outou.

verses.en: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
verses.sm: to Ua toe fetalai mai le ALI ia Aasa, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
verses.sm: Ia e fai mai se faailoga e faia e le ALII lou Atua, ia e fai mai se mea i laló, po o se mea i luga.

verses.en: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Aasa, Ou te le fai atu lava, ou te le faaonoono i le ALI.

verses.en: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Ina faalogologo mai ia le aiga o Tavita, Se mea itiiti ea ia te outou ona faatigaina o tagata, tou te faatigaina ea loʻu Atua?

verses.en: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e tuuina mai ai e le Alii lava le faailoga ia te outou; faauta, e to le taupou, ma fanau mai se tama tane; na te faaigoa foi ia te ia o Emanuelu.!

verses.en: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.sm: E ‘ai e ia le suāsusu toʻa ma le meli, seia iloa e ia ona tetee atu i le leaga, a e filifili i le lelei.

verses.en: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
verses.sm: Aua a o lei iloa e le tama ona tetee atu i le leaga mona filifili i le lelei, e tuua e ona tupu e lua o le nuu ua leaga ia te oe.

verses.en: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
verses.sm: E faaoo mai e le AL ia te oe, ma lou nun, atoa ma le aiga o lou tama, o aso e lei faapea ona oo mai talu ona po na te‘a escese ai Efaraima ma Iuta; o le tupu lea o Asuria.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.sm: O lea aso foi e mapumapu atu ai le ALII i le lago o loo i mulivai o vaitafe o Aikupito, ma le lago meli o loo i le nuu o Asuria.

verses.en: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
verses.sm: Ona latou o uma mai ai lea, ma nonofo i alia, ma mavaevae o papa ma laau tuitui uma, atoa ma taaga uma lava.

verses.en: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.sm: O lea aso e tafi ai e le Alii, i le tafi ua tauia, mai ona tala atu o le vaitafe, o le tupu o Asuria foi lea, e tafia le ulu, ma fulufulu o vae, e salaeseina foi atoa ma le ‘ava.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.sm: O lea aso foi e fafaga ai e le tagata o le povi fafine taanoa ma mamoe e lua.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
verses.sm: E “aina e ia o le suásusu toʻa ona o le tele o le suásusu e maua mai ai; aua e aai le suasusu to‘a ma le meli e i latou uma o e totoe i totonu o le nuu.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
verses.sm: O lea aso foi e i aio laau talatala ma laau tuitui i mea uma sa ¡ai vine e afe, e faatatauina i tupe e afe.

verses.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
verses.sm: Latou te o mai ai ma u fanafana ma aufana; auá e avea le nuu uma ma laau talatala ma laau tuitui.

verses.en: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
verses.sm: O mauga uma foi ua galuea'iina i le suo, e te le alu atu i ai ina ua fefe i laau talatala ma laau tuitui, a e ave i ai povi, e tataa ai foi mamoe. O faatafunaina o Isaraelu ma
